mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which signals potential economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), a slowdown in manufacturing activity signals a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 850.0 thousand units over the past month signals weak consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 850.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), robust retail sales signal economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.
